You know what happens. Something comes up, the familiar response kicks in, and before you know it you’re doing the same thing you’ve done a hundred times before. What would it feel like to finally notice it while it’s happening?

Meet me at The Crossroads: Where Familiar Street Meets the Road Less Traveled—for a reflective journey into what makes real change possible.

Free On-Demand Reflective Experience

What if the next step isn’t more information, but a different way of listening?

Knowing the pattern is one thing. Noticing how you enter it is another.

The Crossroads is an on-demand reflective experience where we’ll get curious about the familiar ways we respond—and what becomes possible when we create enough space to listen differently.

It’s an opportunity to notice something while it’s happening. To listen differently. And to experience for yourself what becomes available when you respond from somewhere other than the familiar.

Together, We’ll Explore

Recognize Your Doorway

The Doorway Check-In helps you notice which familiar way of responding feels most like where you’re entering the experience today. Not a personality type. Not another identity. Simply a place to begin.

Look Beneath the Problem Itself

We’ll explore how different-looking struggles can bring us back to familiar ways of responding—and what they may have in common underneath.

Experience Another Way of Listening

Through a guided reflective experience, you’ll move beneath the busyness of the mind to explore your inner landscape, listen differently, and discover what else may be available.

Hi, I’m Tina.

I’m a Mindful Inner Growth Guide — or, as I like to think of it, a Lantern Holder.

For more than 25 years, I’ve been helping people explore their inner landscape and deepen the relationship they have with themselves.

My work brings together mindfulness, reflection, and self-hypnosis to help you listen to yourself differently—and discover what becomes possible when you do.

I’m not here to tell you which road to take. I’m here to hold the lantern while you discover what’s already there.

There is always more of you to know.

Maybe it’s time to meet yourself at The Crossroads.

An hour to get curious about the familiar ways you respond—and experience what it feels like to listen differently.
